## Scientific/formal voice

An Integration Binding is the versioned, environment-specific link between one selected integration boundary and its exact component identities, package or service versions, configuration, adapter contract, data route, verification evidence and owner Decision, with an attributable activation and successor or rollback route.

### Notation

No notation is required.

### Boundary conditions

- A binding may be drafted before activation but cannot claim an active selection without the exact owner Decision, verified checks and required privacy and operating approvals.
- An option review, lockfile entry, vendor name or synthetic fixture is not a deployed binding.
